text: Artificial intelligence is quickly changing the modern workplace. One of the biggest effects is automation, as AI now handles repetitive tasks like data entry and scheduling. This allows employees to focus on more creative and strategic work. Many companies also use AI-powered productivity tools, such as smart calendars and writing assistants, to help staff work faster and more efficiently. Rather than replacing people completely, AI often supports human-AI collaboration, where workers and machines solve problems together. Of course, these changes mean that some jobs will disappear while new ones appear, so employees need to keep learning new skills to stay competitive in a rapidly evolving job market.
